about.heading: About me
about.p1: I'm a junior programmer, currently studying Systems Engineering, with a year of intensive training in web and backend development. I work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js and Python, and relational and non-relational databases like MySQL and MongoDB.
about.p2: I've taken part in individual and team projects applying Scrum, combining backend logic with frontend creativity: I look for solutions that are efficient and also feel good to use.
about.p3: My goal is to grow into a full stack developer who brings quality and commitment to every project. I'm defined by discipline, adaptability, and enthusiasm for continuous learning.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.subtitle: Short case studies: the problem I solved and how I did it.

items.title: GymMaster CLI
items.problem: Small gyms often track members and payments on loose spreadsheets, with no traceability or quick lookups.
items.solution: An interactive Node.js CLI with MongoDB and Inquirer.js: full CRUD, atomic transactions, and advanced queries to manage members from the terminal.

items.title: INNOVA-ASISTE
items.problem: Student attendance tracking is usually scattered across paper lists and uncentralized files.
items.solution: A Python tool that centralizes recording, editing, and querying attendance with a simple, education-focused approach.

items.title: DataFlix
items.problem: Learning databases from scratch is hard without a free, structured resource that tracks your progress.
items.solution: A web platform with courses, interactive quizzes, and progress tracking, built as a modern, accessible experience.

items.title: ShopVerse
items.problem: Practicing a real e-commerce flow needs consistent catalog data, not just static mockups.
items.solution: An online store connected to the FakeStore API, with catalog, filters, and a responsive shopping experience.

items.title: FoodStars
items.problem: Discovering and sharing trustworthy dining experiences is hard without a centralized platform to explore restaurants and read authentic reviews.
items.solution: A fullstack platform to discover, rate, and share restaurants: restaurant browsing, reviews, and a complete admin panel. React frontend with an Express, Node.js, and MongoDB backend.
